description: This file defines the 'NotEmpty' class, which is part of the minilang operation package in the OfBiz framework. It performs a check to determine if a given field in a map is empty (null or zero length) and adds a message accordingly.

classes.name: NotEmpty
classes.description: A class that checks whether a specific field in a map is empty (null or zero-length) and adds a message if it is.

methods.name: NotEmpty
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the NotEmpty object with an XML element and a process context.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the check to determine if the specified field in the input map is empty; if empty, adds a message to the messages list.
